title: as.tbl_cube.array ignores dim_names argument
description:
`as.tbl_cube.array` is supposed to allow specifying the names of each dimension using the `dim_names` argument. However, it seems that the function ignores this argument entirely, as shown in the reprex below. I think all it is missing is `names(dims) <- dim_names` somewhere in the function.

``` r
library(dplyr)
#> 
#> Attaching package: 'dplyr'
#> The following objects are masked from 'package:stats':
#> 
#>     filter, lag
#> The following objects are masked from 'package:base':
#> 
#>     intersect, setdiff, setequal, union
library(cubelyr)
library(assertthat)

mymat <- matrix(1:100, ncol = 10)
dimnames(mymat) <- list(letters[1:10], LETTERS[1:10])

## Throws an error as expected since the dims are not named
as.tbl_cube(mymat)
#> Error in `glubort()`:
#> ! `dimensions` must be a named list of vectors, not a list
#> Backtrace:
#>     ▆
#>  1. ├─cubelyr::as.tbl_cube(mymat)
#>  2. └─cubelyr:::as.tbl_cube.matrix(mymat)
#>  3.   └─cubelyr::tbl_cube(dims, mets)
#>  4.     └─cubelyr:::bad_args(...)
#>  5.       └─cubelyr:::glubort(fmt_args(args), ..., .envir = .envir)
#>  6.         └─rlang (local) .abort(text)

## Throws the same error even though it shouldn't
as.tbl_cube(mymat, dim_names = c("Row", "Col"))
#> Error in `glubort()`:
#> ! `dimensions` must be a named list of vectors, not a list
#> Backtrace:
#>     ▆
#>  1. ├─cubelyr::as.tbl_cube(mymat, dim_names = c("Row", "Col"))
#>  2. └─cubelyr:::as.tbl_cube.matrix(mymat, dim_names = c("Row", "Col"))
#>  3.   └─cubelyr::tbl_cube(dims, mets)
#>  4.     └─cubelyr:::bad_args(...)
#>  5.       └─cubelyr:::glubort(fmt_args(args), ..., .envir = .envir)
#>  6.         └─rlang (local) .abort(text)

## Same as mymat but the dims are named
mymat2 <- mymat
names(dimnames(mymat2)) <- c("Row", "Col")

## This works, as expected
as.tbl_cube(mymat2)
#> Source: local array [100 x 2]
#> D: Row [chr, 10]
#> D: Col [chr, 10]
#> M: mymat2 [int[,10]]

## This ignores the provided dim_names
new_dnn <- c("TheRow", "TheCol")
res <- as.tbl_cube(mymat2, dim_names = new_dnn)
assert_that(all(names(res$dims) == new_dnn))
#> Error: Elements 1, 2 of names(res$dims) == new_dnn are not true
```

<sup>Created on 2023-07-25 with [reprex v2.0.2](https://reprex.tidyverse.org)</sup>

title: Bad conversion of list measure to tibble
description:
If one of the measures consists of lists then converting the cube to a tibble causes problem. For example:
```
X <- array(lapply(1:4, seq_len), dim = c(2,2))
X_cube <- tbl_cube(dimensions = list(A = c('foo','bar'), 
                                     B = c('x','y')), 
                   measures = list(x = X))

Tmp <- as_tibble(X_cube)
print(Tmp) # Error in `vec_slice()`
```
The problem seems to be that the resulting tibble has a column that keeps its `dim` attribute. That seems to be caused by `as.vector` preserving the attribute (which is mentioned in `help("as.vector")`) in https://github.com/hadley/cubelyr/blob/master/R/cube.R#L180

A possible fix is to simply replace L180 with:
```
mets <- lapply(x$mets, \(m) if (is.list(m)) m[seq_along(m)] else as.vector(m))
```

(This was originally reported in https://stackoverflow.com/questions/61877176/problem-converting-tbl-cube-with-list-measure-into-a-tibble)

title: submit cubelyr to CRAN before submitting dplyr 0.9
description: Package `stars` dynamically imports `as.tbl_cube` from `dplyr`, but that will no longer work with the github `dplyr` version. It would be good to have this package on CRAN before `dplyr` 0.9 is going to be submitted, so that `stars` can be modified in time, or to let me know what to do otherwise.
